title.en: Oplax Span(F) history comparison, Beck-Chevalley characterization, and relational loss obstructions

statement.en: With 0 axioms, Becoming.OplaxHistory proves all-n bracketing coherence and macro refinement for Span(F) chi, equates chi bijectivity with pullback preservation and universal Beck-Chevalley families, constructs emergent/C2 obstructions, and bridges Trace, CausalAbstraction, and GrammarLaws.

laws.en: Any span functor's comparison chi preserves endpoints, commutes naturally, obeys unit, associativity, and composition laws, yields unique BracketTree projections and functorial macro refinement, and RelSpan.mapTrace transports relabeled traces.

chi is bijective iff F maps the composition pullback square to a pullback (chi_bijective_iff_pullback) and iff bcMap is bijective for every observer family E -> D (chi_bijective_iff_bc_all, with empty-family trap bc_empty_family_trivial_counterexample), separated by constructive emergent cross-seam spans (0 -> 1 and 2 -> 4) and C2 equivariant loss spans (2 -> 1 and 2^n -> 1).

Finite Process traces match flatChain pullbacks (trace_equiv_flatChain); ExactCausalAbs lifts force full-chain lifting (exactCausal_lifts_implies_chain_lift, giving exactCausal_lifts_implies_chi_surjective) while CausalGoodhartWitness breaks it; C2CoupledAlignmentWitness realizes FiberViabilitySplit, refuting any sound and complete macro predicate.

Disjoint coproducts preserve pullbacks strictly while time stays oplax (coprod_strong_vs_time_oplax), guarded interchange requires Beck-Chevalley (guarded_interchange_upgrades_iff_bc), reserve serialization joins ConcurrentSerialWitness, and quotient spans reduce to GrammarLaws lumping (span_step_grammar_lumping).

Every SumPreservingFunctor is canonically isomorphic to (- × F Unit) on finite FinPres types (prodUnitToF_isBijective), forcing finite-span chi bijectivity (sumPreserving_finPres_chi_bijective); outside sum preservation, inhabitedOptionFunctor breaks chi surjectivity at 0 axioms (inhabitedOptionFunctor_chi_not_surjective).

hypotheses.en: Constructive Lean 4 Init spans with 0 axioms and 0 private declarations; strong inverse interchange chiInv requires FImageIsPullback or universal bcMap bijectivity across observer families (E : F.obj H.W -> Type, v : F.obj K.W), while FiberViabilitySplit rules out sound and complete macro predicates.

does_not_show.en: Abstract finite-span pullback theorems and C2 parity witnesses never verify that an actual distributed software system, social institution, or learned representation realizes a given SpanFunctor or Beck-Chevalley condition (Rule 2).

Formalizes discrete Type spans and finite-step traces; weak infinite bicategories, continuous-time flows, and probabilistic TV distance floors belong outside (the TV bounds live separately in periphery ObservationalFidelity).
